CustomField.description: When true, a Checkbox question renders the logical inverse of its backing boolean field: the box shows checked when the stored value is false (and vice versa), and toggling stores the de-inverted value. Lets a checkbox read in the opposite polarity of its field (e.g. "Student lives at a different address" over Lives_With_Guardian_1__c) without changing the stored semantics, visibility rules, or companion writeback.
CustomField.label: Invert Display
